name: print-social-conference-speaker-card-indigo-and-lime
title: Conference speaker card with cut-out portrait and confetti stripes
whatItIs: A dark indigo card with a cut-out portrait of a suited man with glasses, a violet 'Speaker' pill, name and title in white, a date block and registration link, coloured pill confetti behind his shoulder, and a row of sponsor logos at the base.
whatItMeans: Professional but festive; bright pill shapes lend energy to a formal portrait.
techniques: Cut out the subject and let coloured pill shapes peek behind his shoulders.
Use a small role pill above the name as a label.
Set date and link in a bordered block at the lower left.
Close with a sponsor logo strip.

vocabulary.definition: A graphic introducing one event speaker.
Small rounded capsules scattered as decoration.
A rounded label naming a role.
